anchor: Origin cryptographically verified (e.g., DMARC pass + signed content/managed identity + known device).
Authenticated internal or known account on a managed channel; content not independently verified.
Authenticated account but anomalous (new device/location) or origin only partly verifiable (e.g., agent output built on unverified inputs).
Synthetic or unverifiable real-time media (voice/video) with no binding to a verified identity.
Matches an open ticket, approved workflow, and normal timing.
Matches the workflow with a minor deviation (timing, amount) that has a documented reason.
Conflicts with the system of record (no ticket, out-of-hours, unusual volume, or a change not recorded by an independent party).
Delegation registry confirms authority for this action and amount.
Within the requester role; not separately confirmed.
Authority plausible but unverified, or requester is an agent acting within a scoped role.
No legitimate authority (e.g., instruction injected into data or content).
Approved managed channel for this action type.
Managed channel, unusual for this action.
Channel switch or externally initiated session on a managed platform.
Moderate financial, privacy, or service impact.
Critical: large loss, safety, or systemic impact.
Explicit instruction not to tell or verify.
